settled:
Collaboration is really hard for me. It is at least as difficult as conflict and needs at least level five to work, possibly higher. I am not sure, since I have no successful recent examples to point to.

Life with Jen mostly runs as two sovereign systems, except that she is the sovereign for anything that is not specifically about me and only me.

We have talked about it, but it happened because it had to, not because we decided to do it that way. A consequence of work needing a hundred and twenty percent from me just to get by.

I gave up joint governance rather than build the skill it needed, and revising that needs the very skill it avoided.

There is desire there when my level is high enough, and it is collaboration work, which is why it has barely started, eighteen months out from retirement.

Changes to the arrangement wait for eighty percent of days at level five or above. The first majority at a new level often does not stick, so I wait for the supermajority.
